items.label: Benefits
items.value: Said to help with neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain, poor circulation, recovery from illness, cuts, burns, chronic skin conditions, and more, as well as gastrointestinal issues and chronic muscular rheumatism.

items.label: Onsen Characteristics
items.value: Known for its smooth feel on the skin. High heat-retention means you stay warm long after bathing, making it a good choice for elderly guests and families.

items.label: Source Information
items.value: Continuously fed with fresh spring water (kakenagashi), drawn from a source welling up in Toyako Onsen town on the shore of Lake Toya within Shikotsu-Toya National Park.

waterQuality.label: Spring type
waterQuality.value: Sodium calcium chloride hot spring (weak salt hot spring)

benefits.label: Efficacy
benefits.value: Neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain, cold sensitivity, convalescence, cuts, burns, chronic skin diseases, etc. It is also effective for gastrointestinal diseases and chronic muscle rheumatism.

characteristics.label: Features of hot springs
characteristics.value: Features slippery skin feel. Since it has a high thermal insulation effect and it is difficult to cool the water, it is recommended for elderly people and families.

sourceInfo.label: Source Information
sourceInfo.value: The source spring flows from Lake Toya, on the banks of the Shikotsu Toya National Park "Lake Toya", using the source spring that springs up in the Toyako Onsen town.
